hooks.name: Targeted quality review
hooks.description: Selects only the verification relevant to the files changed in the task.

action.prompt: Before completing a task that changed project files, inspect the changes for scope and run the smallest relevant validation. For Java changes, prefer the affected Maven test or compilation check; for frontend TypeScript/Vue changes, prefer typecheck or the affected Vitest test; for Docker/Nginx/configuration, validate syntax where practical. Do not run unrelated full suites, do not change unrelated files, and clearly report any validation blocked by unavailable dependencies or network access.
